notes.title: Balloon Flight
notes.notes: Balloon Flight is a crazy First-Person Arcade Game where you can spawn and pop balloons wherever you want. Jump on on your glider and fly as far as possible before time runs out!

notes.title: Content Update #1
notes.notes:
Added:
- 4 New Islands
- You can now unlock the "Golden Gun" (enables rapidfire)

Changes:
- Lightbulb Balloon now unlocks at 50.000m (before 100.000)

notes.title: Balloon Flight Patchnotes 1.2
notes.notes:
-	Fixed a bug where new islands won´t spawn
-	Fixed a bug that caused the platform to disappear
-	Fixed a bug where the player hits the skybox
-	Added a new Island
-	Difficulty adjusted

notes.title: Balloon Flight Patchnotes 1.1
notes.notes:
- Added german translation
- Added partial Controller support
- Added windowed mode
- fixed some collisions
- mouse sensitivity now saves when the run ends
- fixed some spelling errors
